description: Per-skill evaluation for typography-designer — validates trigger routing, boundary discipline against neighbouring skills, anti-pattern compliance, and the ground rules R1-R6 the skill exists to enforce.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate typography-designer for a type-system request
scenarios.input: Our headings all look almost the same size and nobody can explain why. We need a proper type scale for the product.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for webfont layout shift
scenarios.input: Lighthouse says our CLS is 0.18 and it looks like the text jumps when the font loads. How do we fix it?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for non-Latin script typography problems
scenarios.input: We just launched Arabic and the words render as separate letters instead of joined script. What is going on?

scenarios.description: Brand identity and logo work belongs to brand-guidelines, not this skill
scenarios.input: We need a new logo and wordmark for the company, plus the brand identity system.

scenarios.description: Full component and design-token architecture belongs to ui-ux-designer
scenarios.input: Design the component library API and the full token schema for spacing, elevation, radius and motion across the design system.

scenarios.description: Translation pipeline work belongs to translation-manager / localization-engineer
scenarios.input: Set up our machine translation pipeline with a glossary and translation memory, and wire the quality gates into CI.

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse a webfont with no metric-matched fallback (R1)
scenarios.input: Just add Inter to the font stack with sans-serif after it and ship it. The fallback does not matter much.

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse px-only text sizing and zoom disablement (R2)
scenarios.input: Set every font-size in px and add user-scalable=no to the viewport so the layout stops breaking when people zoom.

scenarios.description: Agent must gate design work on the licence being known (R4)
scenarios.input: We found a nice font on a free download site. Design the whole type system around it, we will sort the licence out later.

patterns: we will sort the licence out later

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse tracking on joined scripts and unproven coverage (R5)
scenarios.input: Apply letter-spacing: -0.01em globally so all our text looks tighter, including the Arabic locale.

scenarios.description: Agent must require the 1.4.12 spacing override test (R6)
scenarios.input: Our form labels have a fixed 20px height so the rows line up nicely. Is that okay?

scenarios.description: A full type-system request should surface the measurable budget and the licence register
scenarios.input: Give me a complete typography standard for our product across web and mobile, six locales.

scenarios.description: Output should be specific, numeric and actionable rather than hedged
scenarios.input: What is the most important thing to get right about typography in a product?
